name: Bernuy-Zapardiel (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically crimson and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bernuy-Zapardiel (a wavy bend between a figure and a tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Bernuy-Zapardiel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Bernuy-Zapardiel arms — wavy bend, figure and tree
